proved_locally: exactly three cells and one of each kind are required
deployment boundaries and secret domains must be distinct
secret references cannot be reused across cells
generic Supabase admin and generic database credentials are rejected
issuer, writer and worker secret capabilities are mutually constrained
the canonical topology fingerprint is independent of cell and operation ordering

custom Postgres login users are provisioned and rotated
cross-cell transport is authenticated and replay-safe
bounded_claim: R69 proves a content-free topology manifest compiler. It does not provision services, roles, credentials, KMS permissions, queues or provider access.
next_gate: Define authenticated cross-cell job envelopes and a credential-provisioning runbook, then verify the topology against disposable deployment and Supabase environments.
